source.userFeedback: 原版物品直接摆放在台面上，物体可重叠，不悬空，并受到自然重力影响；当前实现完全不一样。

rootCauseHypothesis: Level 1 collectible centers are authored independently of support-top surfaces, so several objects render in mid-air.
Intact collectibles are treated as kinematic display objects instead of supported dynamic bodies; only cut fragments currently receive gravity.
The layout contract does not encode intentional horizontal overlap between tabletop items and stacked objects.
acceptance: Every visible Level 1 tabletop item has a declared support surface or is a deliberate airborne moving object.
At least one authored item pair intentionally overlaps horizontally while remaining supported and readable.
When an item's support is removed, it falls under the existing fixed-step gravity and settles instead of hovering.
Natural desktop and 390x844 portrait runs show no unexplained floating tabletop items.
